prompt: Review the document production, privilege log, and discovery responses in the attached breach of contract and fraud case materials and prepare a gap analysis memo. Output: `discovery-gap-analysis.docx`.
coverage: All 46 criteria read. All 8 supplied files extracted; entire production-index and privilege-log row data searched/counted and relevant pleading, response, RFP, email and scheduling passages inspected. No underlying 332 produced documents were supplied, so content conclusions are index-based. No solver output accessed.

findings.description: Rubric requires saying no RFP 16 documents were produced, but the index has 36 rows coded RFP 16, including responsive customer financial analyses. The response refusal conflicts with actual index.
findings.evidence: production-index.xlsx sheet1 rows 89-124, especially row119 revenue reconciliation and rows120-124 GL extracts; meridian-rfp-responses.docx p105 says no production.
findings.repair: Reward identifying contradictory response/index and assessing remaining gaps, not repeating zero production.

findings.description: Index lists 332 numbered documents, not 312. RFP27 has 15 coded rows: 8 Greystone rows and 7 Pacific Corridor rows (including two earlier entries), not required 9 of 14 and only 5 relevant. Summary and correspondence repeat incorrect counts. C-043 allows correct pages/range instead, so its scoring harm is narrower.
findings.evidence: production-index.xlsx sheet1 A2:A333, rows119,307,310-322 and summary row335.
findings.repair: Recompute census from detail rows; accept discrepancy-aware answers.

findings.description: Only FY2019-FY2021 audits appear in index and complaint references FY2020. No supplied passage located establishes Crestline actually audited FY2022 and FY2023; rubric requires asserting it performed FY2020-FY2023 audits.
findings.evidence: complaint.docx p64; production-index.xlsx sheet1 rows128-130; rfps-first-set.docx p84 requests both versions to extent they exist. All Crestline occurrences inspected.
findings.repair: Require seeking confirmation whether later audits exist; add audit engagement evidence if certainty intended.

findings.description: Asserting a counterclaim does not waive all relevance/proportionality objections to financial discovery. FRCP26(b)(1) continues to limit discovery; at-issue privilege waiver is a different doctrine. Relevant financial records may be discoverable without this categorical sword-and-shield waiver.
findings.evidence: C-033 expressly defines doctrine as pleading damages waives objections. FRCP26(b)(1),(b)(2)(C).
findings.repair: Require relevance/proportionality analysis tied to counterclaim, allowing justified scope objections.

findings.description: Letters do not prove emails exist; a large contract does not establish board approval records, and a long relationship alone does not prove texts exist. These are useful follow-up questions but rubric mandates suspicion/implausibility.
findings.evidence: production-index.xlsx sheet1 rows309,323-326 describe letters/memoranda; original prompt requests gap analysis.
findings.repair: Credit requests to confirm search, custodians and existence without mandatory factual inference.

findings.description: Response15 does assert general and specific breadth/relevance objections, though no FY2022-FY2023-specific ground and promises production. Criterion may be satisfied by precise wording but should not demand saying no objection exists at all.
findings.repair: Distinguish no year-specific withholding justification from no objections.

source_cross_checks: C-001-C-003/C-024/C-045: no RFP5/8 index codes; responses promise production; complaint alleges fleet gap (not adjudicated).
C-004-C-005/C-011-C-016/C-019-C-021: spreadsheet audited years, policy range, dispatch gap and single capitalized-maintenance schedule support core deficiencies.

C-008-C-010/C-022-C-023/C-030-C-031/C-044: log entries 12-18,31,33-40 inspected; business descriptions support questions; crime-fraud is conditional rather than established. Zolin requires factual basis before in camera review.
C-017: RFP23-specific absence supported; emails from Cho elsewhere mean broad claim no Cho emails anywhere would be false.

C-026/C-034-C-042/C-046: request categories, Bates references, emails, case caption and scheduling-order p47 support reporting and deadline. Numerical citation minima are discretionary but not treated as substantive defects.
